description: Build perfectly formatted UTM campaign URLs with validation and one-click copy.

faqs.a: utm_source identifies the traffic source (e.g. newsletter), utm_medium the channel (e.g. email), and utm_campaign the promotion name. Term and content are optional extras for paid keywords and ad variants.
faqs.q: What do the UTM parameters mean?

faqs.a: Yes — if your URL already has a query string, new parameters are appended with & instead of ?. Existing parameters are preserved.
faqs.q: What if my URL already has parameters?

faqs.a: No. The URL is built entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

howto: Paste your base URL (it is validated).
Fill in utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign (term and content are optional).
Your tagged URL builds live below.
Copy it, or click "Open" to test it in a new tab.
